title.narrative: Development of export consortia in the Valle del Cauca Region of Colombia in the agro-industry and cosmetic sectors

description.narrative: In February 2015, a meeting was held in Bogota, Colombia, between the Ministry of Commerce, Industry and Tourism, KOICA (local team and the HQ-based Assistant Manager of the Latin America Section) and the UNIDO Representative. In this meeting KOICA and gov. counterpart asked for UNIDO#s assistance to develop export consortia of agro-industry/cosmetics# producers in the Valle del Cauca. The UNIDO project would be a component of an approved programme developed in close coordination with the Ministry of Commerce, Industry and Tourism. Cooperation details were then further explored in the course of a joint UNIDO-KOICA mission to the field at the beginning of April and following visit of an international export consortia expert, who presented its findings to KOICA and counterpart at the beginning of May.
